JD- Python GenAI Required Skills & Qualifications




Experience: 5-14 Years


5 Years of Strong Python development experience
Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLMs
Mandatory: LangChain and LangGraph
Experience building RAG applications
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini
FastAPI/Flask development experience
Knowledge of vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Understanding of AI Agents / Multi-Agent architectures
Nice to Have
CrewAI, AutoGen, PydanticAI, Semantic Kernel
AWS, Azure, or GCP
Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
Responsibilities
Develop and deploy GenAI applications using Python
Build agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph
Design and optimize RAG pipelines
Integrate LLMs and vector databases
Deliver scalable, production-ready AI solutions



Were conducting an in-person interview drive on Sunday, 27th September 2026 in Hyderabad Office. If you're interested in exploring this opportunity, please share your updated CV at anup_goud@epam.com and feel free to contact me at 9346352967 for more details.
